name: upstox-bond-sell-no-card
describes: A bond sell at Upstox, which no card prices (W-179 G5). Since W-177 the broker's unscoped maintenance card is the fallback (a null scope matches anything, ChargeScheduleResolver), so the trade resolves to a card with no applicable rule: NO_MATCHING_RULES, Rs 0. Before W-177 the same trade was NO_SCHEDULE. Both are gaps; Zerodha already behaved this way.
